rules_text.raw: The damage dealt increases to 2d10 points of fire damage. Any creature that fails its saving throw also catches fire ( Core Rulebook 444). The continuous line of fire pushes against all creatures, making them treat the spell’s area as difficult terrain.

augmentations.name: Augmented (4th)
augmentations.raw: If you expend two uses of mythic power, you create a second line of fire using your other hand. If you overlap the lines, creatures in the overlap must attempt two saving throws and take the lower result, but don’t take damage from both lines. You may stop either line of fire as a free action on your turn, but once you stop maintaining a line, you must cast mythic firestream again to recreate it.
